tools.name: ledger_track
tools.description:
Record a spend entry for an AI agent on any payment rail, with optional token counts.

No signup: the first call for a new agent_id mints an agent_secret and
returns it in the response — save it, every later call for that same
agent_id must pass it back or the write is rejected. Amounts are capped
a

tools.name: ledger_set_budget
tools.description:
Set spending caps for an agent. Warns at 80%, blocks spend when exceeded
— enforced: a ledger_track call that would cross the cap is rejected.

Dollar caps (monthly_cents/daily_cents) and token caps (monthly_tokens/
daily_tokens) are independent dimensions: dollar caps only cover
non-"tokens" rails,

tools.name: ledger_report
tools.description:
Spend report for an agent over a rolling window.

Returns total spend, breakdown by rail and by service, budget status
(ok/warning/exceeded), detected anomalies, and entry count.

tools.name: ledger_alerts
tools.description: Alert history for an agent: budget warnings (80% threshold) and spending spikes.

tools.name: ledger_list_agents
tools.description:
Owner-only: full cross-tenant listing of every agent ever claimed on
this instance, with totals. Requires the operator's admin_secret — this
is a portfolio-wide view, not a per-agent report (use ledger_report for
that, which needs no secret).

tools.name: ledger_api_docs
tools.description:
Self-serve documentation for AgentLedger — quickstart, MCP tools, REST
endpoints, budget caps, error codes, and idempotency usage, as markdown.

tools.name: ledger_examples
tools.description:
Complete, runnable Python recipe for a common AgentLedger integration
pattern.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ledger_track · Private data: ledger_rotate_secret, ledger_revoke_secret, ledger_track, ledger_set_budget, ledger_report, ledger_alerts, skills_list_tool, read_skill · Public sink: ledger_track · Destructive: ledger_rotate_secret.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ledger_track · Private data: ledger_rotate_secret, ledger_revoke_secret, ledger_track, ledger_set_budget, ledger_report, ledger_alerts, skills_list_tool, read_skill · Public sink: ledger_track · Destructive: ledger_rotate_secret

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ledger_track" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
